offline_reproduction.method: clean git archive; npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts; npm run build; npm pack --ignore-scripts

vendored_directory.runtime_package_manifest_note: The vendored package.json removes upstream build scripts and devDependencies so a file: install cannot invoke tsup or expand the app lock. Runtime exports, peer dependencies, package identity, and the exact source commit are retained.
vendored_directory.text_materialization_note: The actual vendored bytes are authoritative and fully bound by the tree manifest. Relative to the pinned offline pack the generated JavaScript, source-map, and declaration files are byte-identical; no post-build text edit was applied, because the pinned commit already carries the approved terminology and the published protocol, toolkit, and article identifiers.

license.caveat: The pinned upstream commit declares MIT but did not contain a standalone license file. The author-supplied vendored LICENSE.md notice resolves that packaging omission for this release while preserving the historical source-commit fact.
